```{r, include=FALSE}
library(exams)
library(mathml)
library(htmltools)
library(mistakes)

hook(s2_pool, subscript(s^2L, pool))
hook(x_A, subscript(mean(X), "A"))
hook(x_B, subscript(mean(X), "B"))
hook(n_A, subscript(n, "A"))
hook(n_B, subscript(n, "B"))
hook(s_A, subscript(s, "A"))
hook(s_B, subscript(s, "B"))
hook(quant, subscript(t, "0.975"))
hook(mu0, subscript(mu, 0L))
hook(se, italic(SE))

task <- "confint5"
plfile <- file.path("rexams", sprintf("%s.pl", task))
rolog::consult(system.file(plfile, package="mistakes"))

source("utility.R")

## DATA GENERATION
repeat
{
  n_A <- sample(20:25, 1)
  n_B <- n_A + sample(-5:5, 1)

  if(n_A == n_B)
    next

  x_A <- round(runif(1, 5, 15), 1)
  x_B <- round(runif(1, 3, 13), 1)

  if(x_A == x_B)
    next

  s_A <- round(runif(1, 3, 6), 1)
  s_B <- round(runif(1, 3, 6), 1)

  if(s_A >= x_A || s_B >= x_B || abs(s_A - s_B) < 0.5 || abs(s_A - s_B) > 3)
    next

  quant <- round(qt(0.975, n_A + n_B - 2), 2)

  Q <- quote(search(confint5, confint5(n_A, n_B, x_A, x_B, s_A, s_B, quant), .S, .R, .P, .E))
  S <- findall(Q, options=list(preproc=as.rolog), env=environment())

  if(problems(S))
    next

  break
}

t <- prepare(task=task, S)
sol <- format_feedback(t$correct, t$explanations, t$bugs, t$praise, t$blame, t$extra)
```

Question
========

In an environmental psychology study, participants were randomly assigned to one of two information-based interventions. 
Participants in Condition A ($N=`r n_A`$) received information about animal welfare and the environmental impact of food choices. 
Participants in Condition B ($N=`r n_B`$) received information about animal welfare only. 
For each participant, the number of vegetarian meals chosen over one week at the university’s cafeteria was the primary outcome.
In Condition A, $\overline{X_A}=`r x_A`$ vegetarian meals were chosen compared to the $\overline{X_B}=`r x_B`$ chosen in Condition B. 
The standard deviations are respectively $s_\mathrm{A}=`r s_A`$ and $s_\mathrm{B}=`r s_B`$.

Assuming equal population variances in the two, calculate the two-sided $95\%$ confidence interval.
The 97.5th percentile of the $t$-distribution with $`r n_A + n_B - 2`$ degrees of freedom is $`r quant`$.

```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(t$alternatives, markup="markdown")
```

Solution
========
The two-sided $95\%$ confidence interval is calculated by: `r t$solution`

```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
sol <- lapply(sol, FUN=gsub, pattern="\\n", replacement="")
answerlist(sol, markup="markdown")
```
